name: plopino
description: Publish an HTML page, a document, a file, or a folder to Plopino and get a public link.

tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Publish an HTML page to a public URL and get a shareable link.

html.description: The complete HTML document to publish, including the <html> tag. Must be self-contained: relative references to local files do not resolve.

update_url.description: A URL returned by an earlier publish. When given, that page's content is replaced and the link stays the same. Requires a Plopino token.

url.description: Public link to the published page.

note.description: Human-readable status: created vs updated, and how long the page is kept.

tools.name: publish_path
tools.description: Publish a local file, zip, or directory to a public URL and get a shareable link; documents render as readable pages.

path.description: Absolute path to a file or directory on this machine. Directories are uploaded recursively (symbolic links skipped); zips are unpacked server-side.

update_url.description: A URL returned by an earlier publish. When given, that page's content is replaced and the link stays the same. Requires a Plopino token.

url.description: Public link to the published page.

note.description: Human-readable status: created vs updated, and how long the page is kept.

token.title: Plopino token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to publish anonymously — that is the default flow and needs no account. A token from plopino.com/b publishes to your account instead: private boards, in-place updates that keep the same link, and no per-IP rate limit.
